events.details: Ceased as an ISP (c. 2000 stands) — Patash Pty Ltd survives as a hosting/DNS/mail provider (ABN active); no retail internet access.. The retail ISP homepage died between Jul 2005 and Feb 2006; the 'still live' proposal confuses the surviving Patash hosting company with the defunct ISP.

refs.label: patash.com.au redirects to a live, orderable WHMCS storefront for hosting/DNS/mail services under Patash Pty Ltd
Operating entity ABN active and GST-registered
Full retail ISP homepage on 17 Jul 2005.
By 4 Feb 2006 the homepage was an empty stub (same FVAW digest through Dec 2006); Jul 2008 capture is webmail-only; 2015 site says 'Today the Patash mission is
Company still trades in 2026 as a hosting/domains business (WHMCS) with no internet-access plans — alive as a host, dead as an ISP.
